challenger.application: BABA's z at D(s) ranked against the panel cross-section at D(s); common_IPCA = beta_BABA(s) * F_SPY(window)

characteristics.standardisation: cross-sectional rank to [-0.5, 0.5] per date across names with valid values; drop a date with < 30 valid names
characteristics.vol_63: std(ddof=1) of the last 63 daily log returns

challenger.comparison: vs M1 on the S0 criterion on TUNE (Gamma never sees TUNE), with TRAIN printed and labelled IN-SAMPLE for Gamma; a failed criterion prints KILL/HOLD-AS-RESEARCH

estimability.otherwise: print CHALLENGER NOT ESTIMABLE with those coverage counts and log the 3 configs as not-estimable

challenger.gamma: 4 numbers = pooled OLS, no intercept, of r_i,t on [f_t, mom*f_t, vol*f_t, rev*f_t] over the TRAIN panel only (t < 2024-01-01)
challenger.model: beta_i(t) = z_i(t-1)' Gamma; z = [1, mom_12_1, vol_63, rev_21]

admit_if: schema has the adjusted close column
bars on >= 95% of NYSE sessions in [2012-01-03, 2026-09-30] (index dates only)
universe.iteration: data/yahoo/*.parquet at BASE in ascending sha256(path) order
universe.record: runs/s1_residual/CHALLENGER_UNIVERSE.json: admitted path + blob id, files examined, rejected-by-reason counts

clock.anchor: session s on the subject's market calendar (BABA MARKET_US; 9988/0700 MARKET_HK)
clock.decision_cutoff: D(s) = last session before s on the same calendar; every decision-cutoff quantity uses bars <= D(s) only
clock.disclosure: the day-s move close(D(s)) -> close(s) is excluded from every decision-cutoff input and this is disclosed
clock.leg_rule: close(coverage)/close(fill) - 1 on the adjusted (TR) close; both endpoint bars on EXACTLY those sessions else ABSTAIN_MISSING_ENDPOINT; cites engine/qledger.py _leg_ret_in_window L2540
clock.window: resolve_horizon_window(entry_anchor = calendar day before s, h, HORIZON_UNIT_TRADING, market); assert fill_date == s

determinism.check_flag: --check runs into a temp dir and byte-compares every output file against runs/s1_residual/ (the ledger compared after dropping 'ts'), exit 0 iff identical
determinism.ledger_ts_exception: the ledger's 'ts' is the only wall-clock value
determinism.seal_verification: the runner first recomputes every membership_sha256 and the prereg digest and exits non-zero on any mismatch with the seal

info_leak_predicate.action: TUNE RETIRED for every protocol using that series (P01, P03-BABA); TUNE still computed and printed, labelled NON-CONFIRMATORY — TUNE RETIRED (A23 INFO-LEAK)
info_leak_predicate.hk_series: no raw column: VINTAGE_UNVERIFIABLE — disclosed, NOT retired
info_leak_predicate.honesty_note: a window return is invariant to a multiplicative adjustment constant across the window; the leak is the vintage, not necessarily the value
info_leak_predicate.ledger_row: TrialLedger.log_trial inside the register_trials block, after the budget row; family sni.s1_residual.<Pxx>; source sni_s0_holdout_retirement; detected_at = BASE commit date (deterministic)
info_leak_predicate.manifest_row: one LANE_MANIFEST.json row with successor 'Pxx v2 — not drafted; owner = seat/S0'
info_leak_predicate.train: never retired; an empty split prints EMPTY — retirement not applicable
info_leak_predicate.window: date >= earliest TUNE anchor of any protocol using that series AND <= the input vintage (last bar)

kill_hold_rule: a failed pre-declared criterion prints KILL/HOLD-AS-RESEARCH; it is never rescued by changing the target, cohort or horizon (REG §5 quoting masterplan L268)
labels: HISTORICAL-DESCRIPTIVE (non-confirmatory); REG §2 not met; nothing here is a forecast, a signal, or authority
identity = RETROSPECTIVE JOIN (A07), identity_resolved_as_of = security_master ingested_at

manifests.built_before: any outcome; outcome-free builder reads ONLY market calendars and the subjects' index dates (never a price/volume column)
manifests.membership_sha256: per (protocol, subject, h, split): sha256 of that split's lines in canonical order

mirror_trick.block: one non-overlapping anchor unit (h+1 sessions >= h)
mirror_trick.cluster_variable: cluster key = trade date of s
mirror_trick.construction: CI of mean(x): block_bootstrap_ci(dates=concat(k,k), vals=concat(x,-x), mask=concat(1,0), stat='mean'), default draws/seed (800/7)
mirror_trick.law: D9 — the ONLY permitted bootstrap use for a mean
test_properties: identity vs the hand gap computation
constant series c -> [c, c] to 4 dp

out_of_scope_note: nothing under data/ or research/single_name_intelligence/protocols/ is created or modified; no qledger register call (L2026); no forecast store, grader, registry, scheduler, queue, router or agent definition

baselines.trail63: sign of trailing-63-session excess at D(s): (P_BABA(D)/P_BABA(D63)-1) - (P_SPY(D)/P_SPY(D63)-1), D63 = 63 sessions before D(s) on the NYSE calendar; both series need bars on D and D63 exactly else direction 0

bench.role: US market factor / bench, adjusted TR close

P01.excess: subject_ret - bench_ret, simple returns on the adjusted TR close (grade_claim convention, qledger L2698/L2812); each leg reproduces _leg_ret_in_window L2540
P01.hit_rule: hit = (sign(excess) == direction); excess == 0 exactly -> non-hit, listed as a tie; direction 0 -> ABSTAIN (listed, not a hit, not a miss)

H0_2.interval: mirror-trick block-bootstrap CI on mean excess (D9)
H0_2.sidedness: two-sided (frozen at this seal; REG did not fix sidedness — recorded as a GAP)

P02.baselines: as P01 (D63 on the HKEX calendar)

bench.role: HK market factor / bench, FIXED at the seal for v1; 3033.HK is not a P02 bench

P02.exclusions: RMB counters are never subjects; the two subjects are never pooled

P03.calibration: per model and split: coverage of |z| <= 1.96 vs nominal 0.95 and |z| <= 1 vs 0.6827, wilson_ci; stability = TRAIN vs TUNE coverage side by side plus mean/std of beta__dc per split
P03.cohort: confirmatory-in-principle cohort = BABA only: M1 vs M0 and M2 vs M1 at 3 h (6 configs); 9988/0700 decompositions print as DESCRIPTIVE — outside the P03 cohort (V0 row 14 / X7): 12 configs, logged as trials
P03.column_naming: decision-cutoff quantities carry __dc (beta_*__dc, sigma_hat__dc, n_obs__dc); observation-cutoff quantities carry __oc (r__oc, F_*__oc, common__oc, resid__oc, z__oc)
P03.fit: OLS with intercept of the subject's daily log return on factor daily log return(s) over the last 252 subject bars <= D(s), inner-joined on dates; require >= 200 joint observations else ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY

incremental_criterion.decision: next beats prev on a split iff delta_R2 > 0 AND CI lower bound > 0 (approximately one-sided alpha 0.025); else print KILL/HOLD-AS-RESEARCH — never retarget, re-horizon or swap the cohort
incremental_criterion.statistic: for a pair (prev, next): d_i = (r - c_prev)^2 - (r - c_next)^2 over units where BOTH are OK; delta_R2 = sum(d)/sum(r^2)

models.M0: zero model (common = 0); sigma_hat = std(ddof=1) of in-window subject daily log returns
models.M2: market + sector: BABA SPY + KWEB; HK 2800.HK + 3033.HK
models.disclosures: BABA is a KWEB constituent — the sector factor carries the subject; KWEB is never a Tencent quote; the M2 circularity is disclosed and accepted at the seal

P03.nature: contemporaneous decomposition, NEVER a pre-move forecast
P03.outcome: r = log(close(coverage)/close(fill)); F = the same window log return of each factor; common = sum(beta_k * F_k) (intercept excluded, disclosed); resid = r - common; sigma_hat = std(ddof=1) of the in-window daily OLS residuals; z = resid/(sigma_hat*sqrt(h))
P03.returns: daily and window LOG returns on the adjusted close
P03.spec_hash: sha256 of canonical JSON {model, subject_security_id, factors, window:252, min_obs:200, h, return:'log', intercept:'excluded_from_common'}

report.analysis_set_text: PRIMARY = SENS-A = SENS-B (no event bundling for rolling anchors, IL §4)
report.twin: runs/s1_residual/results/<Pxx>.json with the same ten fields in the same order; a test asserts the field order

rolling_anchors.cluster_key: trade date of s; cluster-N == honest-N for rolling units (both printed)
rolling_anchors.first_anchor: first session s on the subject's calendar with >= 252 subject bars <= D(s)
rolling_anchors.honest_n: per (protocol, subject, h, split); NEVER summed across subjects, counters, horizons or protocols (A22)
rolling_anchors.no_pooling: BABA and 9988 are the same issuer group: never pooled; different protocols (P01 vs P02) or separate rows (P03)
rolling_anchors.spacing: next anchor = the session h+1 sessions after the previous anchor (non-overlapping windows, no shared endpoints)
